_comment: Quran tab knobs, read only by components/quran/.
_comment-first-paint-rows: Rows drawn before the surah shows, more than fill the first screen; the rest follow in a render the browser may interrupt, so a long surah appears as fast as a short one.
_comment-split: A phone splits the reader, surah over study. share is the surah's part at first, least the smallest either pane keeps, step how far one arrow press moves the bar.
_comment-no-touch: Reading without touching the words. hold-ms is long enough that a tap never reads as a hold; hint-ms is how long the hint stays; a flick slows by drag per millisecond and stops below still.
